title: MCPGuard v0.2 versioned contracts
description: Canonical source. RA-08 adds safe download preparation and authenticated private one-time claim. Automatic client contexts, activation and formal new-resource execution remain planned.

expiresAt.description: Ticket expiry, bounded by credential lease expiry.

x-credential-format.envelopeEncoding: UTF-8 compact JSON in generated CredentialEnvelope property order; no trailing bytes
x-credential-format.plaintext: UTF-8 compact JSON in generated CredentialReference property order; reference metadata only
x-credential-format.nonceReservation: A random 96-bit nonce is durably reserved under the real key fingerprint before encryption; reservations are never reused or deleted.
